Present есть; у меня есть = I have. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be; there is'.
future: буду / будешь ... + infinitive

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

включить.gloss: to turn on, to plug in

meanings.en: to switch on, to plug in

examples.trans: I'll plug it in right now.

examples.text: Сейчас включу. Он у нас быстро всё вспомнит.
examples.trans: I'll plug it in right now. He'll remember everything quickly with us.

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Disbelief.
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
+ infinitive: не даёт мне готовить
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.en: to achieve, obtain; to win over
meanings.note: + gen (or colloquially acc of person)

examples.text: Я всё равно вас добьюсь, Марина!
examples.trans: I will win you over anyway, Marina!

examples.text: Мы оба сами многого добились в жизни.
examples.trans: We both achieved a lot in life on our own.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

related.gloss: to get on, for life to go (impersonal)

meanings.note: Спасибо за + accusative.
+ instrumental.
Location. Core Russian adv meaning 'here' in everyday speech.
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me
Кажется as a parenthetical word.

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

meanings.note: + infinitive.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: Colloquial.
Как мужик = like a real man.

examples.trans: You should have acted like a real man!

examples.text: Что мы, мы? Тебе надо было как мужик!
examples.trans: What do you mean, we? You should have acted like a man!

meanings.note: colloquial for мультипликационный фильм

examples.trans: This is like in a cartoon.

examples.text: Это я управляю тобой, как в мультике!
examples.trans: It is I who control you, like in the cartoon!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'we' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'большой').

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.

examples.text: Мы живём в небольшом тихом городе.
examples.trans: We live in a small, quiet town.

examples.text: Извините, у нас тут небольшой бардак.
examples.trans: Excuse us, we have a bit of a mess here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
+ genitive. Core Russian part meaning 'no; there isn't' in everyday speech.
usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: + genitive.
Тошнит от = sick of.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.note: intransitive reflexive verb with infinitive or от + genitive

examples.trans: He refused to sign the report.
Really? Did he refuse to sign it?

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

examples.text: Мы готовимся к переезду в Москву.
examples.trans: We're getting ready to move to Moscow.

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.text: А вашу работу вернуть можно. И мы хорошо платим.
examples.trans: But we can get your job back for you. And we pay well.

examples.text: А вы мне тоже айфон подарите?
examples.trans: Will you give me an iPhone too?

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Once, for a while.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: Это правильно = that's right. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

examples.trans: New Year is a family holiday.

examples.text: Это семейный праздник. Как в детстве, с подарками!
examples.trans: It's a family holiday. Like when we were kids, with presents!

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Сам, сама, само, сами.

Чужой человек = a stranger. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('someone else's, foreign').

examples.text: Вы так и берёте чужое без спроса, да?
